qa_pair.question: The response of the parts list query includes exactly one field that must be unique across all parts and is limited to at most 20 characters. What is that field called?

To report that purchased goods have arrived, the Purchase area's ReportArrival command takes a nested set of locations. Each location can instead name a brand-new part location that does not yet exist. What is the exact documented condition under which the location's name field is mandatory?
qa_pair.answer: If reporting to a new location.
